SBA_PPP_150K_PLUS.name: SBA PPP FOIA - loans $150K and above

MA.registry_unavailable_note: No free bulk Massachusetts registry or original trade-license dataset is available (see unavailable sources). Organization dates are unknown, so no Massachusetts business can be marked ready.

unavailable_sources.name: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, Corporations Division: entity organization dates
unavailable_sources.reason: No free bulk data. 950 CMR 113.15 offers the full Corporations Information Management System extract only for purchase ($4,800/year or $100/week; file layout on request). The public search (corp.sec.state.ma.us) is per-entity and protected by bot detection (Incapsula), so it is not queried automatically.

unavailable_sources.name: Original issue dates for Massachusetts plumbing/gas-fitting and sheet-metal business licenses (DOL eLIPSE)
unavailable_sources.reason: Plumbers and Gas Fitters and Sheet Metal boards are on eLIPSE, which offers per-license lookups only. The MA Professional Licensing API requires a key issued to municipalities/vendors. The free OPSI facility export (madpl.mylicense.com) has no plumbing/HVAC business licenses.

unavailable_sources.name: OpenCorporates mirror of Massachusetts registry (us_ma)
unavailable_sources.reason: Requires an API token (HTTP 401 without one), and it is a third-party mirror rather than the SOC record.

unavailable_sources.name: Per-loan web page on data.sba.gov
unavailable_sources.reason: SBA publishes only bulk CSVs; loan evidence links point to the CSV plus the LoanNumber.

unavailable_sources.name: Original issue dates for Texas HVAC (TDLR) and plumbing (TSBPE) licenses
unavailable_sources.reason: TDLR 'All Licenses' (7358-krk7) publishes license number, holder and expiration date only; no original issue date. TSBPE publishes no bulk open dataset with original license dates. Trade-license dates are therefore never used; SOS charter/COA dates are the only record dates.

unavailable_sources.name: Texas SOS filing history (SOSDirect)
unavailable_sources.reason: Paid, login-only per-entity search; no bulk open access. Conversion/merger history that can reset a charter date is not checked.

unavailable_sources.name: Per-loan web page on data.sba.gov
unavailable_sources.reason: SBA publishes only bulk CSVs; loan evidence links point to the CSV plus the LoanNumber.
